data.body: Completion verifier verdict: DD1-DD4, DD6-DD7 PASS. DD5 scope clarification: the DD5 behavior (arbiter logs warning when reconstruction_gaps=true and treats missing cycles as unknown) is reader-side arbiter logic, not part of the write infrastructure built in this story. This behavior is deferred to S3 (arbiter BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schema story, 0652-809a-d1fc-4d36) which implements the arbiter's cycle-count logic. A consideration has been added to S3. Write infrastructure (script, contract doc, 30+10 tests) is complete.
